numbers.label: Number 41
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape (Index, Middle, Ring, Pinky extended upright with thumb tucked flat against palm), then transition to Index finger upright ('1').

numbers.label: Number 42
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then transition to '2' handshape (Index and Middle upright, Ring and Pinky tucked).

numbers.label: Number 43
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then transition to '3' handshape (Thumb, Index, Middle extended upright with fingers spread).

numbers.label: Number 44
numbers.instruction: Hold '4' handshape (4 fingers upright with thumb tucked) and bounce outward or forward twice.

numbers.label: Number 45
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then open and flare all 5 fingers wide with thumb extended outward.

numbers.label: Number 46
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Pinky tip ('6' handshape) with remaining 3 fingers upright.

numbers.label: Number 47
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Ring tip ('7' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 48
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Middle tip ('8' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 49
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Index tip ('9' handshape) with remaining 3 fingers upright.

numbers.label: Number 50
numbers.instruction: Begin in '5' base handshape (all 5 fingers open), then actively close/pulse fingers into an 'O' shape.
